_real_world.designation: YJ-83 (ship-launched baseline; US designation CSS-N-8 family; export variant C-802)
_real_world.role: Primary anti-ship cruise missile (ASCM) on Type 054A and Type 054B, box-launcher-fired (2 quad launchers, 8 missiles per hull)
_real_world.range_nmi: 100-135 nmi depending on variant (csg-cn-054a-usni-proc-202006, csg-cn-054b-usni-proc-202503, both B); ONI 2015 gives the YJ-83 family ~65-120 nm (A-tier, ship variants generally)
_real_world.guidance_real: INS midcourse + active radar terminal seeker (csg-cn-yj83-janes, B, describing the closely related air-launched YJ-83K -- ship-launched YJ-83 guidance assumed identical per family convention, no ship-specific guidance source found)
_real_world.speed: Mach 0.9 subsonic sea-skimming cruise (csg-cn-yj83-wiki, C-only, describing the missile family generally)
_real_world.launch_platforms: Type 054A (8x, 2 quad box launchers), Type 054B (8x, 2 quad box launchers); also Type 056/056A corvettes (not in this packet's OOB)
_real_world.mount_mapping: No functional NavalWeaponType mount exists for box-launched ASCMs in this engine; status content_only_no_mechanism, referenced from both frigates' weapon_inventory
_real_world.air_launched_variant_note: The air-launched YJ-83K/YJ-83KH variant has distinct sourced figures in the OOB (csg-cn-yj83-janes, B): YJ-83K max range 180km, YJ-83KH max range 230km, guidance YJ-83K active-radar-terminal vs YJ-83KH imaging-IR-terminal, length 5.3m, mass ~700-800kg (C-tier for mass). These are NOT modeled in this record, which covers the ship-launched baseline only. Packet 4 (carrier air wing) should write a separate CSG_CN_YJ-83K record for J-15T/J-15DT carriage using these figures rather than reusing this ship-launched record, since guidance and range differ by launch platform.
